items.source: Spring Data Neo4j or in short SDN is the next-generation Spring Data module, created and maintained by Neo4j, Inc. in close collaboration with VMware’s Spring Data Team. It supports all officially supported releases of Neo4j, including Neo4j AuraDB. The Spring Data Neo4j project applies aforementioned Spring Data concepts to the development of solutions using the Neo4j graph data store.
items.translation: Spring Data Neo4j（简称 SDN）是下一代Spring Data模块，由Neo4j, Inc.与VMware 的Spring Data 团队紧密合作创建和维护。 它支持所有官方发布的 Neo4j 版本，包括 Neo4j AuraDB。 Spring Data Neo4j 项目将上述 Spring Data 概念应用于基于 Neo4j 图数据存储的开发解决方案中。

items.source: Concepts that are important to understand are Neo4j Bookmarks, the potential need for incorporating a proper retry mechanism such as Spring Retry or Resilience4j (we recommend the latter, as this knowledge is applicable outside Spring, too) and the importance of read-only vs write queries in the context of Neo4j cluster.
items.translation: 需要理解的重要概念包括 Neo4j 书签、引入适当重试机制的潜在需求（例如 Spring Retry 或 Resilience4j，我们推荐后者，因为该知识不仅适用于 Spring 框架），以及在 Neo4j 集群环境中只读查询与写入查询的重要性。

items.source: The core functionality of the Neo4j support can be used directly, through either the Neo4jClient or the Neo4jTemplate or the reactive variants thereof. All of them provide integration with Spring’s application level transactions. On a lower level, you can grab the Bolt driver instance, but than you have to manage your own transactions in these cases.
items.translation: Neo4j 支持的核心功能可以通过直接使用 Neo4jClient、Neo4jTemplate 或其响应式变体来实现。 它们均提供与 Spring 应用级事务的集成。 在更底层，您可以获取 Bolt 驱动实例，但在这种情况下需要自行管理事务。

items.source: Please make sure you read the Frequently Asked Questions where we address many reoccurring questions about our mapping decisions but also how interaction with Neo4j cluster instances such as Neo4j AuraDB and on-premise cluster deployments can be significantly improved.
items.translation: 请阅读常见问题解答，其中我们解答了许多关于映射决策的重复性问题，同时也说明了如何显著改善与 Neo4j 集群实例（如Neo4j AuraDB）和本地部署集群的交互。

items.source: SDN relies completely on the Neo4j Java Driver, without introducing another "driver" or "transport" layer between the mapping framework and the driver. The Neo4j Java Driver - sometimes dubbed Bolt or the Bolt driver - is used as a protocol much like JDBC is with relational databases.
items.translation: SDN 完全依赖 Neo4j Java Driver，未在映射框架与驱动之间引入额外的“驱动”或“传输”层。Neo4j Java Driver（有时被称为 Bolt 或 Bolt 驱动）作为协议使用，其方式类似于关系型数据库中的 JDBC。

items.source: SDN is the official successor to prior SDN version 5, to which this documentation refers as SDN+OGM. SDN version 5 used a separate object mapping framework, much in the way Spring Data JPA relates to JPA. That separate layer aka Neo4j-OGM (Neo4j Object Graph Mapper) is now contained in this module itself. Spring Data Neo4j itself is an object mapper, dedicated to be used in Spring and Spring Boot applications and in some supported Jakarta EE environments. It does not require or support a separate implementation of an object mapper.
items.translation: SDN 是先前 SDN 版本 5（本文档中称为 SDN+OGM）的官方继任者。 先前的 SDN 版本 5 使用了一个独立的对象映射框架，其工作方式类似于 Spring Data JPA 与 JPA 之间的关系。 该独立层，即 Neo4j-OGM（Neo4j 对象图映射器），现已包含在此模块内部。 Spring Data Neo4j 本身是一个对象映射器，专为在 Spring、Spring Boot 应用程序以及部分受支持的 Jakarta EE 环境中使用而设计。 它不需要也不支持单独的对象映射器实现。

items.source: We provide repositories as a high-level abstraction for storing and querying documents as well as templates and clients for generic domain access or generic query execution. All of them are integrated with Spring’s application transactions.
items.translation: 我们提供 存储库 作为存储和查询文档以及模板的高级抽象，同时也为通用领域访问或通用查询执行提供客户端。 它们全部与 Spring 的应用程序事务进行了集成。

items.source:
SDN is an Object-Graph-Mapping (OGM) library.
An OGM maps nodes and relationships in the graph to objects and references in a domain model.
Object instances are mapped to nodes while object references are mapped using relationships, or serialized to properties (e.g. references to a Date).
JVM primitives are mapped to node or relationship properties.
An OGM abstracts the database and provides a convenient way to persist your domain model in the graph and query it without having to use low level drivers directly.
It also provides the flexibility to the developer to supply custom queries where the queries generated by SDN are insufficient.
items.translation:
SDN 是一个对象图映射（OGM）库。  
OGM 将图中的节点和关系映射到领域模型中的对象和引用。  
对象实例被映射为节点，而对象引用则通过关系进行映射，或序列化为属性（例如对 Date 的引用）。  
JVM 基本类型被映射为节点或关系的属性。  
OGM 抽象了数据库，提供了一种便捷的方式来在图中持久化您的领域模型并进行查询，而无需直接使用底层驱动程序。  
它还赋予开发人员灵活性，以便在 SDN 生成的查询不足时提供自定义查询。

items.source: Noteworthy features that differentiate the current SDN version from prior SDN+OGM are
items.translation: 当前 SDN 版本与先前 SDN+OGM 相比，具有值得注意的差异化特性，包括：

items.source: SDN is a complete OGM on its own
items.translation: SDN 本身就是一个完整的 OGM。

items.source: Full support for immutable entities and thus full support for Kotlin’s data classes
items.translation: 完全支持不可变实体，从而全面支持 Kotlin 的数据类。

items.source: Full support for the reactive programming model in the Spring Framework itself and Spring Data
items.translation: Spring 框架本身及 Spring Data 全面支持响应式编程模型。

items.source: Neo4j client and reactive client feature, resurrecting the idea of a template over the plain driver, easing database access
items.translation: Neo4j 客户端和响应式客户端功能，复活了在基础驱动之上使用模板的理念，从而简化数据库访问。

items.source: You still can use Neo4j-OGM, even in modern Spring Boot applications. But you cannot use it with SDN 6+. If you tried you would have two different sets of entities in two different - and unrelated - persistence context. Hence, if you want to stick to Neo4j-OGM 3.2.x, you would use the Java driver instantiated by Spring Boot and pass it onto a Neo4j-OGM session. Neo4j-OGM 3.2.x is still supported, and we recommend its use in frameworks such as Quarkus. In a Spring Boot application however your primary choice should be SDN.
items.translation: 即使在现代 Spring Boot 应用中，您仍然可以使用 Neo4j-OGM。但您无法将其与 SDN 6+ 配合使用。如果您尝试这样做，将在两个不同且无关的持久化上下文中拥有两套不同的实体。因此，如果您希望继续使用 Neo4j-OGM 3.2.x，请使用由 Spring Boot 实例化的 Java 驱动程序，并将其传递给 Neo4j-OGM 会话。Neo4j-OGM 3.2.x 仍受支持，我们推荐在 Quarkus 等框架中使用它。然而，在 Spring Boot 应用中，您的首选应该是 SDN。
